t.zh: 一支竖着的箭从光轴立起，高 H。箭的两端各有一条光线穿过小孔，两条线在像平面上截出的那一段，就是箭的像，高 h。
t.en: An upright arrow stands H tall on the axis. A ray from each end passes the hole, and the stretch the two rays cut out of the image plane is the arrow's image, h tall.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：物体离得越远，像矮多少？换一支镜头，像又高多少？第一个任务只能前后移动箭，第二个任务箭不动，只能调像平面到小孔的距离 f。像高等于圆圈标出的高度才算对；先想好，再按「检查」。
t.en: This level asks: how much shorter does an image get as the object moves away, and how much taller with another lens? The first task moves only the arrow in depth; in the second the arrow stays and only f, the plane's distance from the hole, turns. It is right when the image is as tall as the circled mark; decide first, then press Check.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="perspective-scaling"></wiki-ref>：像高 h = fH/Z，和距离成反比、和 f 成正比。距离加倍，像缩成一半。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="perspective-scaling"></wiki-ref>: the image height h = fH/Z, inversely proportional to distance and proportional to f. Twice as far, half as tall.

brief.zh: 箭高 H = 2，f = 2：只前后移动箭，让像高 h = 1。
brief.en: The arrow H = 2 tall, f = 2: move it only in depth so its image is h = 1 tall.

hint.zh: Z = 2 时像和箭一样高。像要变成一半，距离要怎样变？
hint.en: At Z = 2 the image is as tall as the arrow. For half that, how must the distance change?

why.zh: 以为距离多 1，像就矮 1：Z = 3 时像高是 1.33。像高按 1/Z 变，要矮一半，距离得加倍。
why.en: Taking one step back for one unit off the image: at Z = 3 it is 1.33 tall. Height goes as 1/Z; half as tall needs twice as far.

brief.zh: 箭高 H = 2，离小孔 Z = 8：箭不动，只调 f，让像高 h = 0.75。
brief.en: The arrow H = 2 tall, Z = 8 away: leave it there and turn only f, so its image is h = 0.75 tall.

hint.zh: f = 1 时像高 0.25。要三倍高，f 要怎样变？
hint.en: At f = 1 the image is 0.25 tall. Three times as tall needs what f?

why.zh: 以为差多少补多少：f 加 0.5，像高只到 0.375。像高和 f 成正比，要三倍高，f 也要三倍。
why.en: Adding what is missing: f up by 0.5 brings the image only to 0.375. Height is proportional to f; three times as tall needs three times f.
